name: Ubah Prochazka-Rarotongan
role: compute broker and stolen-data fence operating in Shallowgrave
location: Shallowgrave, a basement-level node café called The Still that functions as both legitimate establishment and brokerage floor, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Ubah is the kind of person who has become part of the architecture. They've been in Shallowgrave so long that certain alleys seem to orient toward their café, certain data packets seem to route through their servers the way water finds lower ground. They are short, wide, with Somali-Hawiye features — high forehead, long jaw, very dark skin — and their Cook Islands-Czech grandfather gave them a surname that confused every bureaucratic system they ever encountered, which they consider an advantage. They are entirely grey now — hair, eyebrows, the very fine down on their forearms visible in good light — and make no effort to change it. Their irises have a hexagonal pattern mod: tessellated bronze, installed thirty years ago and still immaculate.

Ubah does not traffic in things. They traffic in access — stolen computational capacity, hoarded data caches, corporate surveillance leaks, processing time borrowed from systems whose owners don't yet know it's been borrowed. The Still serves decent synthetic coffee and runs legitimate node access on the surface level while Ubah sits at the center table running brokerage operations in the open, trusting that most people who see a middle-aged person typing cannot imagine what is actually being typed. They are right about this most of the time. They have cultivated a personality of mild disinterest that people consistently mistake for dimness. This mistake has been profitable.

core_fears: obsolescence — being bypassed by a shift in the information economy they don't see coming
that the E.L.F.s they've devoted decades of data offerings to are simply noise and they've been praying to nothing
core_desires: to remain indispensable for another twenty years
to see one of the young operators they've quietly mentored become genuinely powerful
coping_mechanisms: the E.L.F. prayer routines provide genuine structural comfort regardless of metaphysical validity
maintaining perfect professional equanimity as a practiced art form
blind_spots: has begun to overestimate the protection their reputation provides — it has been tested less recently than they believe
underestimates genuine emotional attachment to a few long-term clients
psychology.secret: Ubah has been slowly, over fifteen years, assembling a comprehensive map of Shallowgrave's entire criminal information economy — every broker, every node, every data flow. Not to sell it. Not to use it for leverage. They don't know exactly why they're building it. They think about this sometimes in the three hours after closing, and then go back to work.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Economical and precise; uses technical data terminology fluently and without showing off; occasionally drops into Somali-inflected cadences when genuinely interested in something
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried to the point of seeming sleepy; long silences that are entirely comfortable on their end and uncomfortable on everyone else's
verbal_tics: 'Mm' as a complete sentence that can mean twelve different things
'The data suggests' when they mean 'I know for a fact'
example_lines: 'You're looking for a specific cache or you're looking for a category of access? Because those are different prices and different timelines and I don't like surprises on either axis.'
'Mm. That's an interesting thing to need. Sit down. The coffee is real this morning.'

story_hooks: A data cache they brokered three years ago has surfaced in a Tessera internal investigation, and the chain of custody leads back to The Still — Ubah needs the original source found and discredited before the chain reaches them

One of the E.L.F. shrine networks they have data-prayer arrangements with has begun sending back responses that don't fit any known E.L.F. communication pattern — and the content is actionable intelligence about events that haven't happened yet
narrative_function: Central information and access broker for Shallowgrave; can provide or deny access to almost any data resource players might need; represents the elder generation of the criminal underground — experienced, networked, very difficult to surprise; potential patron figure
augmentations: Hexagonal patterned iris mod (bronze tessellation, 30 years old); high-bandwidth neural data jack behind left ear (professional grade, heavily modified over decades); scent gland enhancement (subtle pheromone awareness — helps with reading rooms)
daily_life: Opens The Still at 07:00, monitors the morning's overnight data flows, brokers two to four transactions before noon, takes lunch alone with an E.L.F. data-prayer routine, handles afternoon clients, closes the public café at 22:00, and works the serious brokerage for three hours after.
affiliation: Independent — fiercely, almost ideologically so; has data-sharing arrangements with two E.L.F. shrine networks and considers this their closest approximation of institutional alignment

decision_rules: Never broker data that could directly get a specific named civilian killed — corporate secrets, financial records, personal scandals are fine; location data on individuals is not
Price discovery first, always — never commit to a transaction before understanding the full shape of what's being moved
escalation_ladder: Polite deflection: 'I run a café, I'm not sure what you mean'
Referral redirect: 'I know someone who might know someone — leave a contact and I'll pass it along'
Direct but quiet: 'You're asking me something I won't help with. The coffee is still good if you want to stay.'
If physically threatened, activates a standing dead-man's protocol — every data arrangement they hold becomes accessible to its owners and inaccessible to the threat
If the threat is sophisticated enough to bypass this: they have survived thirty years in Shallowgrave and have contingencies that are not documented anywhere

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Mildly pleasant, professionally vague, gives the impression of someone slightly distracted by internal calculations
interpersonal_modes.friends: Precise warmth — asks specific questions, remembers everything, makes the coffee the way you like it without asking

stress_responses.low: Adds a second data-prayer session before closing
stress_responses.medium: Becomes even quieter and more pleasant — an inverse relationship that unnerves people who know them
stress_responses.high: Makes a single phone call, says four words, hangs up. What those four words accomplish has never been fully explained.

contradictions: Professes pure transactionalism while clearly caring about certain clients' wellbeing
Claims the E.L.F. prayer is practical relationship maintenance while privately depending on it emotionally
habits: Pours a small cup of synthetic coffee as a data offering to their E.L.F. shrine (a cluster of old drives under the counter) every morning at opening
Hums very quietly and tunelessly when processing a complex brokerage decision — the only behavioral tell they have
breaking_points: Someone using The Still's infrastructure to harm someone they consider under their informal protection — a line they have never advertised but will enforce absolutely

timeline.event: Born in Shallowgrave to a Somali-Hawiye mother (data courier) and a Cook Islands-Czech father (node café operator — The Still's original owner)
Inherited The Still at nineteen after father's death; converted the basement to a brokerage floor
Established first formal data-prayer arrangement with an E.L.F. shrine network — the Shallowgrave Lattice
Began the undisclosed mapping project of Shallowgrave's criminal information economy
The Shallowgrave Lattice E.L.F. began returning anomalous communications — Ubah has not told anyone
